title: Rank-based merit list to replace percentile for NEET PG: Panel to SC
content: The National Medical Commission has officially approved a shift from a percentile to a rank-based system for NEET admissions, which aims to improve the current postgraduate medical course admission process. This change comes amid concerns over the possible decrease in qualifying scores for NEET-PG 2025. The commission is focused on preserving the integrity of medical examinations and has also suggested equitable salary structures for medical residents.

title: 'Will move to Israel, become PM': Trump jokes on his approval ratings amid US midterms
content: In a lighthearted moment during a Fox News interview, Donald Trump playfully proposed his candidacy for the position of Israel's prime minister, citing a staggering 99 percent approval rating among Israelis. He went on to declare that by 2026, the US would cease its annual aid of $4 billion to Israel, sparking considerable debate over the implications for military support and relations, coinciding with the midterm elections unfolding in America.

title: Billionaire Mark Cuban to Gen Z: Listen to Jeff Bezos’ advice; just get a job
content: Mark Cuban advises young workers to seek any job to gain practical experience and manage workplace expectations. Both Cuban and Jeff Bezos believe that initial employment develops valuable skills like responsibility and teamwork. They highlight the importance of understanding how businesses operate and contributing to productivity. Early jobs can serve as stepping stones for future career advancement and personal growth in professional settings.

title: Where Is Bashir Zeb Baloch? Mystery mounts after BLA announces leadership change
content: Baloch Liberation Army Commander-in-Chief Bashir Zeb Baloch has stepped down from his position. The announcement has led to speculation about his status and possible assassination attempts. Reports on pro-Pakistan social media allege he was poisoned or killed in military action. The BLA clarified that a leadership transition was decided during a council meeting. The group assured that military operations will continue uninterrupted until a new leader is appointed.

title: Class 12 student starts women-only running club, raises Rs 8L for streetlights
content: With the launch of RunX, Kridha Gupta aimed to establish a safe running community for women in Ambala. As memberships surged, the group pivoted towards campaigns for enhanced public safety and lighting. Their proactive community engagement led to successful fundraising for streetlights, alongside productive dialogues with local governance. Additionally, Kridha's initiative included educational workshops for students, illustrating how collective actions can foster substantial community growth.

title: Katy Perry's 110-acre youth camp faces opposition from 360 neighbours
content: Katy Perry’s proposed Gratitude Canyon youth camp in Goleta, California, is facing opposition from more than 360 neighbours. Residents have raised concerns about wildfire risks, traffic, noise and evacuation access. The singer’s Firework Foundation is defending the project, saying it will provide underserved children with opportunities to explore arts, nature and outdoor activities.

title: Justin Baldoni sells LA home for $2.1M amid Lively legal fight
content: Justin Baldoni has sold his three-bedroom Culver City home for $2.1 million after relocating to Nashville with his family. The ‘It Ends With Us’ director bought the California property for $1.04 million in 2017 and renovated it extensively. The sale comes amid the high-profile legal dispute with former co-star Blake Lively.

title: Scientist builds mini universe of 24k atoms to show time can be measured without a clock
content: At the University of Birmingham, Giovanni Barontini has crafted a captivating mini universe using 24,000 chilled rubidium atoms. This groundbreaking experiment reveals that time can be gauged via entropy variations, offering a fresh perspective beyond traditional clocks. The model aids in probing the inconsistencies between general relativity and quantum mechanics in timing measurements.

title: Tennessee couple loses land claim despite 30 years of mowing and gardening
content: A couple from Tennessee faced a setback as their claim over a strip of land beside their house was overturned by the court. They believed their usage spanning almost 30 years sufficed for establishing ownership through adverse possession. However, the appeals court determined that the couple's evidence fell short of legal standards, highlighting a vital legal principle: merely using land for an extended period does not guarantee ownership.

title: Connor McDavid vs Sidney Crosby: Inside the NHL stars' luxury homes
content: Connor McDavid and Sidney Crosby have established different approaches to luxury living away from the NHL spotlight. McDavid’s reported Edmonton mansion reflects contemporary design, personalised spaces and entertainment-focused amenities, while Crosby’s Nova Scotia lakefront retreat is associated with privacy, nature and a quieter lifestyle. The homes they covered give a glimpse into how two famous NHL captains value comfort outside of hockey.

title: Stephen Curry makes $2.5 million profit from $11 million San Francisco property
content: Stephen Curry has sold his San Francisco commercial property for $11 million, making a $2.5 million gross gain after purchasing it for $8.5 million in 2024. The building was originally intended to become the headquarters of his business venture, Thirty Ink. However, a dispute with the Carpenters Union forced him to abandon the project in 2025. The property has since found a new buyer linked to the artificial intelligence industry.

title: Judge needn't face strictures for typos in judgement: SC
content: In a significant move, the Supreme Court intervened to address remarks made by the Rajasthan high court about a trial judge. This action stemmed from minor errors in a ruling, which the High Court harshly criticized, despite the fact that these did not alter the outcome of the case.

title: Republicans feel the blues as US midterms begin: Key races and faces to watch
content: Current polling trends show that Republicans might encounter difficulties during the midterm elections on November 3, largely due to dissatisfaction among voters. This election is being viewed as a crucial test of the government's performance on vital topics including the economy and immigration. As both House and Senate races remain hotly contested, the results are far from certain, with Democrats aspiring to take advantage of this discontent.

title: 'There are no words': Messi, Mbappé lead football's tributes to Jesús de Miguel
content: In a tragic incident, Jesús de Miguel, a forward for CD Tenerife, passed away following a collision with FC Andorra's goalkeeper Jesús Owono during a second-division match. This collision led to cardiac arrest. The football community expressed its sorrow, and Spanish authorities have launched an investigation. The match was called off, and other games were postponed in his honour.

title: Ladakh admin asks Sonam Wangchuk's school to halt activities amid pending HC case
content: The Ladakh administration on Tuesday issued a notice to the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives (HIAL), founded by Sonam Wangchuk, asking it not to undertake any further activities at Desert Flower School in Phyang until the matter is decided by the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh.

title: Widow faces tax notice for Rs 60 lakh cash deposits; why ITAT gave ‘gift’ relief
content: The Income Tax Department discovered that a woman had deposited Rs 60,07,500 in cash into her bank account during the financial year 2015-16. However, she had not filed an income tax return (ITR) for the corresponding assessment year. The Assessing Officer (AO) subsequently issued a show-cause notice under Section 148A(b) of the Income Tax Act, 1961. As the woman did not respond, the AO passed an order.

title: Rajkumari Chanu scripts history with maiden Wushu bronze at Youth Olympics Games
content: Rajkumari Lanchenbi Chanu created history at the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games by winning India's first-ever Wushu medal, claiming bronze in the women's Changquan combined event with 18.039 points. Her achievement took India's medal tally to three, following silver in judo and bronze in swimming, marking a major milestone for Indian Wushu on the international stage.

title: 'Want Rahul vs PM Modi debate?' Cong MP runs X poll; asks BJP to make it happen
content: On Monday, Rahul had challenged the Prime Minister to an open debate on the allegations of him of becoming Prime Minister with "foreign help" saying the latter would not dare to accept it. The whole showdown began after Rahul retorted to Modi's 'Ekta Diwas' speech, in which the PM accused the opposition of turning into an "obstructionist force" (avrodh paksh).

title: Ranji: Ayush Doseja admits second-season blues after hitting season's first fifty
content: A year on from a prolific 949-run season, Ayush Doseja has faced outside noise and a string of unfortunate dismissals in the Ranji Trophy. The Delhi batter insists his confidence remains intact, credits the Bengal attack for a valuable challenge and believes patience, consistency and an attacking style will help him convert starts into big scores and push towards India A.

title: Rupali Ganguly moves Bombay high court over misuse of AI-Generated photos
content: Rupali Ganguly has recently approached the Bombay High Court regarding unauthorized use of her photographs and videos. She claims that multiple platforms and websites have used her images without consent, including adult websites featuring AI-generated morphed content. Ganguly's lawyer has requested the court to mandate the removal of objectionable content and protect her identity. The actress is recognized for her successful role in the show Anupamaa, which revitalized her career.

title: 'We are heartbroken': UEFA mourns Jesús de Miguel; police open probe
content: CD Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel, 30, has died after suffering serious injuries in a collision with Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono during a Spanish second-division match. Despite receiving emergency treatment, his condition deteriorated, and he passed away on Tuesday. UEFA has expressed its condolences and announced moments of silence at its matches, while Spanish police investigate possible involuntary manslaughter.

title: Russia gives its drones bigger antennas to beat Ukraine's jamming
content: Russia is bolstering its drone attack fleet by integrating more prominent anti-jamming antennas, which are pivotal for securing satellite-navigation signals from interference. This enhancement is meant to ensure drones adhere to their pre-programmed routes amidst Ukrainian electronic warfare efforts. Reports suggest the presence of rapid jet-powered drones that quicken attack cycles.

title: AICWA seeks intervention from PM Modi regarding the security concerns in Bollywood
content: Amitabh Bachchan's recent public appearance, shielded by bulletproof glass, has sparked alarm regarding the safety crisis in Bollywood. The All Indian Cine Workers Association is pushing Prime Minister Narendra Modi to implement stronger security protocols for those in the film industry. The spate of violent attacks and extortion attempts on prominent stars has raised significant concerns, prompting demands for effective safeguards in Mumbai to protect its residents.

title: 'I was disappointed': Why Dhinidhi isn't celebrating her historic Youth Oly medal
content: Dhinidhi Desinghu has made history by clinching a bronze medal in the women's 100m freestyle at the Youth Olympics, becoming the first Indian swimmer to do so. Although she aimed for gold and hoped to shatter the 56-second mark, she expressed disappointment with her performance. This achievement is pivotal for Indian swimming, especially for female athletes.

title: ‘I become CM when I don’t contest elections’: Akhilesh drops hint on UP poll strategy
content: In an engaging media interaction, Akhilesh Yadav, leader of the Samajwadi Party, lays out his interesting political philosophy, noting that he becomes Chief Minister when he abstains from electoral battles. As the assembly elections loom, he reveals plans to reassume his Lok Sabha role, underscoring the necessity of auspicious timings for nomination submissions in Kashi. His statements showcase a creative electoral approach as he positions himself ahead of the elections.

title: Trump's torment: From draining the swamp to drowning in mid-terms?
content: As Americans head to the polls for the pivotal midterm elections, the stakes couldn't be higher for Trump's administration. Current polling trends indicate a potential shift towards Democratic control in Congress, which could complicate Trump's legislative agenda. Historically, presidents facing an opposing Congress have encountered significant roadblocks, underscoring the potential for ongoing investigations and contentious budget negotiations.

content: The three-judge bench also rejected the BMC's plea for an additional 30 days to complete the task. It said the civic body must comply with the court's earlier directions before seeking further relief.

title: Trump hails Republican gains in Guam, links them to US midterms hopes
content: Donald Trump's Truth Social post on Republican gains in gubernatorial election . he congratulates candidate Tony Ada and suggests result could signal wider gains for his party in the midterm elections . the results are subject to certification by the Guam Election Commission .

title: US midterms 2026: Could a Trump defeat in Congress alter the Iran war?
content: a democratic takeover of the house of representatives would give the opposition greater power to investigate the administration’s handling of the conflict . but Trump would remain commander-in-chief, with the authority to direct US military operations . congress does have powers over war and military spending, but using them to force a president to change course is difficult .

title: MP Rajya Sabha bypoll: Puri set to win unopposed as nominations of 2 others rejected
content: the nomination papers filed by two candidates were rejected by the returning officer . the two independent candidates also objected to Puri's nomination papers . a returning officer examined the objections and held that Puri had not violated any requirements of the People Act .

title: Desi romance with Trump is fading amid racism and immigration bite
content: a new survey by the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace finds that the Republican gains have largely evaporated, with Indian-Americans swinging back towards Democrats ahead of the November 2026 midterms . 62 per cent of ind-am citizens intend to vote Democratic in their congressional district, against just 19 per cent backing Republicans .

title: 1.5-tonne Nasa observatory to re-enter Earth today; debris may fall in India
content: Nasa's 1.5-tonne Swift space observatory will re-enter the atmosphere on friday . some parts of its debris could fall over southern India . most surviving debris is expected to fall in southern india . the spacecraft was launched in 2004 to explore the universe's most powerful explosions .

content: SC says no group, political party, NGO or civil society outfit can occupy a protest site indefinitely . it stresses need to balance the right to protest with traders’ and daily-wagers’ livelihoods . the court asked a traders’ association to implead the protest organisers in the case for determination of compensation .
